description: Payload of device.command.v1: set one writable parameter of an active device. Producer: control plane (DeviceCommandService::confirm, for direct and automation commands), through the outbox claim. Consumer: runtime devices-control (handleControl, dispatch). At least once; the runtime deduplicates by command_uuid. Fences: generation, the applied configuration_uuid and session_id. The message around it is {uuid, type, payload, lease_token?}.

generation.description: The device deployment generation the command was confirmed under; the runtime cancels a command whose generation is not the device's current one.

session_id.description: The source session the runtime's command check reported at confirmation, or null when it reported none. The runtime fails the command when the source session at dispatch differs; it reads null as an empty session, which never matches.
